description: The figure contains two pie charts labeled (a) and (b) that depict the proportional distribution of token/category labels (shown as words/symbols in the legends) for two different cases. Chart (a) has 6 slices with percentage labels shown outside the wedges and a legend above the chart; the slices are labeled “the” (blue with diagonal hatching, ~31%), “this” (blue with horizontal hatching, ~21%), “for” (green with crosshatch, ~17%), “chemical” (light green with dotted/mesh hatching, ~15%), “to” (yellow with wavy hatching, ~9%), and “in” (light blue with vertical striping, ~7%). Chart (b) has 5 slices with percentage labels outside and a legend above; the slices are labeled “the” (blue with diagonal hatching, ~38%), “$” (red with dotted hatching, ~27%), “equilibrium” (yellow with wavy hatching, ~19%), a small gray-labeled category shown as a gray swatch in the legend (gray with dotted fill, ~15%), and an additional gray rectangular swatch also present in the legend area (appearing as a legend entry but not clearly readable as a text label). Neither chart shows exploded/offset slices, and the wedges appear arranged roughly from larger to smaller proportions around the circle.
